info.title: Script and Voiceover to B-roll Video Engine
info.description: Production-grade engine that ingests video scripts, scene plans, and audio narration to synthesize fully synchronized 1080p B-roll videos, subtitle tracks, timelines, and manifests.

get.description: Fast liveness check verifying the application process is running.

Deep readiness check evaluating:
1. Database connectivity
2. Output storage directory write access
3. Free disk space against configurable threshold (MIN_DISK_FREE_BYTES)
4. Media pipeline binaries (FFmpeg & FFprobe)
5. Background worker state
Returns active runtime constraints and validation boundaries.

post.description:
Submits a validated script-to-video render job.
Accepts scene definitions, aspect ratio, resolution, and optional public audio URL.
Supports Idempotency-Key header or deterministic body fingerprint to avoid duplicate processing.

post.summary: Create job with optional audio upload
post.description:
Submits a render job with either an uploaded audio file or a validated audio URL.
Explicit rejection rule: Providing BOTH an uploaded audio file and an audio URL will result in HTTP 400.
Supports Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate submissions.

post.summary: Probe and validate an external audio URL
post.description: Checks whether an audio URL is reachable, valid, bounded in size, and safe from SSRF.

get.description: Fetches real-time status, progress, stage, and manifest for a given job ID.

post.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or active job.

get.description: Lists generated artifacts (video, timeline, captions, manifest) with sizes, hashes, and download links.
Securely downloads a generated artifact file, enforcing path-traversal and file-access protection.

post.description:
Splits continuous script text into coherent scenes using punctuation boundaries and length constraints,
preserves original narration text verbatim, and calculates positive durations according to audio or cadence.

post.summary: Rank candidate visual media by relevance
post.description:
Ranks candidate visual media against a visual description using multi-feature relevance scoring
(TF-IDF lexical cosine, n-gram phrase match, tag alignment, duration fit, aspect ratio compatibility).
Exposes full auditable reasons and component breakdown.

get.description: Returns active media providers, health status, and remote capability flags.

schema.title: Response List Media Providers V1 Providers Get

get.summary: Search B-roll candidates from lawful providers
get.description:
Searches lawful media providers for B-roll clips matching query keywords,
validates license compliance, and records provenance metadata.
Preserves backwards compatibility with initial starter pack test contracts.
